events.title: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in DRC
events.summary: WHO DON (28 Aug 2026): 5794 confirmed cases, 2786 deaths (CFR 48.1%) in DRC; outbreak expanding to 60 health zones.

events.title: Measles resurgence in Mexico
events.summary: PAHO (Aug 2026): Mexico reports 19,311 confirmed measles cases and 45 deaths since outbreak start; sustained transmission in children.

events.title: Measles Outbreak in DRC and Somalia
events.summary: Africa CDC (02 Aug 2026): DRC reports 102k measles cases; Somalia reports 285 new cases with 3 deaths.

events.title: Cholera Surge in Mozambique and Angola
events.summary: Africa CDC (02 Aug 2026): Mozambique cholera cases up 205%; Angola cases up 116% in last four weeks.

events.title: Global Cholera outbreaks monitoring
events.summary: ECDC (31 Jul 2026): 132,313 global cholera cases/1,556 deaths in 2026; DRC, Sudan most affected.

events.title: Cholera Outbreak in Karal Health District, Chad
events.summary: OCHA (30 Jun 2026): Cholera outbreak in Karal district caused at least 13 deaths; risk of spread remains high.

events.title: Multi-country Dengue fever surge
events.summary: KDCA (Jul 2026): KDCA W28/2026 (Jul 2026): Americas report >1.5M dengue cases and 748 deaths; Brazil and Argentina most affected.

events.title: Suriname Chikungunya Outbreak Surge
events.summary: IFRC (19 Mar 2026): Suriname confirms 1,357 Chikungunya cases and 1 death since late January outbreak declaration.

events.title: Influenza A(H3N2) activity rising in Southern China
events.summary: China CDC (Aug 2026): Influenza A(H3N2) rising in South, 16.2% ILI positivity, moderate epidemic level.

events.title: Locally acquired Dengue cases in France
events.summary: ECDC (21 Aug 2026): 4 locally acquired Dengue cases in France since 2026; one active cluster remains.
